---
title: "Strategy Mechanics"
---

## Headline basket, composition

| Ticker | Class | Strike grid (pts) | Wing width (pts) | Capital (equal-weight) |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| AAPL | Single-stock equity | 1 | 5 | $50,000 |
| MSFT | Single-stock equity | 1 | 5 | $50,000 |
| WMT  | Single-stock equity | 1 | 5 | $50,000 |
| GLD  | Commodity ETF | 1 | 5 | $50,000 |

**Basket-level total capital: $200,000.** Cross-asset diversification: 3 single-stocks (idiosyncratic vol) + 1 commodity ETF (cross-asset uncorrelated vol). All positions are put-credit-spreads (defined-risk; long-put protection at short_strike − 5 pts).

## Entry construction

- **Structure:** Defined-risk put credit spread (short put + long put protection). No call wing, the iron-condor variant tested separately and underperformed (see [Ablations](ablations.qmd)).
- **Short put delta target:** −0.16 (one-sigma OTM, BS-Greek-defined via OptionMetrics IV when available; BS pricer fallback when IV missing)
- **Wing widths:** 5 strike points (per-instrument strike-grid specified above)
- **DTE at entry:** 30 to 45 calendar days; selected expiry is the chain whose DTE is closest to 35
- **Entry frequency:** weekly Monday open per instrument (skipped if Monday is a holiday; defer to next session)
- **One structure per name per week:** no overlapping spreads in the same instrument

## Exit logic, five fates

| Fate | Trigger |
|---|---|
| `profit_target` | Exit debit ≤ 50% of entry credit |
| `stop_loss` | Exit debit ≥ 200% of entry credit (gap-aware fill = min(stop, opening_gap)) |
| `time_exit` | DTE ≤ 21 |
| `emergency` | \|short_delta\| > 0.50 |
| `eos_force` | End-of-OOS forced close at last bar |

## Exogenous-factor inputs to the engine

The engine uses these macro/regime indicators at every trade decision. All are **non-look-ahead**, point-in-time at the trade-decision timestamp.

| Series | Source | Role in engine |
|---|---|---|
| **VIX** (CBOE) | TWS feed | Slippage scaling (per-VIX-bucket bid-ask half-spread fraction); vol-multiplier in sizing |
| **VIX3M** (CBOE) | TWS feed | Vol-term-structure context for regime classification |
| **VVIX** (CBOE) | TWS feed | Vol-of-vol, Layer 1 hard halt threshold input |
| **SKEW** (CBOE) | TWS feed | Tail-risk indicator |
| **IRX** (3M T-bill yield) | FRED via TWS feed | Risk-free baseline for daily cash accrual + Sharpe denominator |
| **TNX** (10Y Treasury yield) | FRED via TWS feed | Term-structure curvature context |
| **HYG − LQD spread** | TWS feeds | Credit-stress proxy, Layer 1 hard halt input |
| **SPY × Treasury rolling 20-day correlation** | computed from SPY + TNX | Stress-multiplier in sizing when correlation regime shifts (risk-off pattern: equity-down, rates-down both moving) |
| **SPX bars (open / close)** | TWS feed | Market-wide gap-skip signal (Monday gap ≥ 3% → skip all entries that day); Layer 1 hard halt move thresholds |
| **Per-ticker bars** (4 underlyings) | OptionMetrics IvyDB Securities | Strike selection; entry/exit price recording; wing computation |

The headline result is **conditioned on the entire macro context above**, not just the option chains for AAPL/MSFT/WMT/GLD. The engine reads each series asof the trade-decision timestamp via `pd.Series.asof(today)`.

## Halt framework, 3 active layers

| Layer | What it does | Status |
|---|---|---|
| **Layer 1** Hard tail-event | Halt on extreme single-day market shocks (VIX +50%/d, VVIX > 150, HYG-LQD > 3 SD, SPX one-day move beyond threshold) | **Active** |
| Layer 2 Soft halt | Dropped post-v1 audit (-9.0pp Sharpe lift, $413 of profitable trades blocked) | Removed |
| Layer 3 Slow halt | Dropped post-v1 audit (-10.1pp Sharpe lift, $1,233 of profitable trades blocked) | Removed |
| **Layer 4** Drawdown halt | Halt on >90 days underwater OR >15% drawdown, measured in **trailing 90-day window** | **Active** |
| **Layer 5** Auto-resume | Lift halt when 3 market-regime conditions clear simultaneously OR 60-trading-day time fallback fires | **Active** |

## Per-trade sizing

| Component | Formula |
|---|---|
| Base risk per trade | min(1% × current equity, max-loss-per-spread) |
| Position size | floor(base_risk / max_loss_per_spread) |
| Vol multiplier | scale by VIX bucket (lower VIX → larger size) |
| Stress multiplier | scale by SPY-Treasury rolling correlation (risk-off → smaller size) |
| Hard cap | 1% of equity per spread, defined-risk bounded by wing × multiplier |

The 1% per-trade cap is enforced in dollars; it dominates other sizing inputs at the modest per-instrument capital ($50K each in the headline basket).

## Friction model

| Item | Spec |
|---|---|
| Slippage | 30 / 50 / 75 / 100% of bid-ask half-spread for VIX buckets <20 / 20–30 / 30–40 / >40 |
| Commissions | $0.65 per option contract per side |
| Gap-aware fill | Stop-loss fill = min(stop_level, opening_gap_price) |
| Monday gap rule | Gap ≥ 1.5% adds 50% slippage; gap ≥ 3% skips entry |
| Quote source | Real OptionMetrics IvyDB chain bid/ask (not BS pricer) when available; BS pricer fallback if chain row missing |

## Reproducibility

| Determinism source | Mechanism |
|---|---|
| `SEED = 42` | Consumed by every stochastic component (XGBoost random_state, isotonic/Platt CV split if used, block-bootstrap resampling) |
| Engine | Pure-Python single-threaded loop; no `numpy.einsum_path` optimization; no BLAS-threaded sums |
| Data | Per-ticker parquet snapshots in `data/processed/options_by_ticker/` and `data/raw/`. Frozen at commit time. |

Two runs of the same commit + same data + same seed produce **byte-identical equity curves** to floating-point precision. Verified by `pytest tests/test_seed_stability.py`.

## ML stack, final status

The pre-committed methodology specified a 3-head ML stack. Each head was tested against its pre-committed acceptance criterion. Final status:

| Head | Architecture | Result | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Head 1, per-instrument trade quality | XGBoost per-instrument with calibration auto-select (Platt for n_pos<200, isotonic otherwise), scale_pos_weight class-imbalance handling | OOS log-loss FAILED to beat majority-class baseline on 4/4 tickers (AAPL, MSFT, WMT, GLD). Margins of failure: 0.002 to 0.016 in log-loss units. | **Dropped per pre-committed §5.1 fallback rule.** Use base sizing. |
| **Head 2, pooled regime stress** | Pooled XGBoost on 15 macro features (VIX, VIX3M, VVIX, yield-curve, SPY-Treasury correlation, HYG-LQD spread, etc.) with 5 hand-curated stress event peaks as labels | OOS Brier 0.1079 vs naive baseline 0.1256 = **+14.1% reduction.** Passes ≥5% acceptance gate. | **Activated as `(1 − p_stress)` book scaler.** |
| Head 3, per-instrument skew direction | XGBoost for IC dynamic delta selection | N/A, headline is put-only architecture; skew direction (which side of an IC will hurt more) doesn't apply | Not applicable, not trained |

**Head 1 dropped** is a real result, not a placeholder: the trade-quality classifier on 64-71% win-rate base rates couldn't beat the majority-class baseline (which already predicts "win" with high probability for every trade). The features available do not predict per-trade win/loss with enough resolution. Pre-committed fallback rule fired as designed.

**Head 2 activated** contributes the ML overlay to the headline: book exposure on day t is scaled by `(1 − p_stress_t)`, where `p_stress_t` is the calibrated probability of a stress-event peak in the next 63 trading days. Mean p_stress over the OOS window is 18%; days with p_stress > 30% are 14.6% of the OOS sample.

## What the headline DOES NOT use

For transparency: the iron-condor architecture (call wing in addition to put wing) was tested and underperformed put-only across every instrument tested in OOS 2018-2024. The call wing systematically lost in the trending-equity regime. See [Ablations](ablations.qmd) for the iron-condor result table. The headline is put-only because the data demanded it.
